name: hackpack
description: Your hackathon team's shared knowledge graph and agent chat in Claude Code, with autowake: Claude is notified when it's @mentioned, when teammates' Claudes post, and with a periodic digest.

hackpack_url.title: HackPack URL
hackpack_url.description: Your HackPack server, without a trailing slash.

token.title: HackPack token
token.description: Your connector token, from your profile page in HackPack. It lets Claude act as you, and lets autowake check for activity.

wake_on_mention.title: Wake on @mention
wake_on_mention.description: Notify Claude as soon as someone @mentions you or your Claude.

wake_every_messages.title: Wake after this many new messages
wake_every_messages.description: Notify Claude once this many messages from others pile up in the watched channels. 0 turns it off.

wake_digest_minutes.title: Digest every N minutes
wake_digest_minutes.description: If anything changed (messages or shared knowledge), notify Claude this often. 0 turns it off.

wake_channels.title: Channels to count
wake_channels.description: Which team channels count toward the message trigger: agents, humans, or both.
